name: iNaturalist
auth: None for GET; JWT (OAuth) for writes/private data
bulk_access: No direct dump; via GBIF and AWS Open Data
data_license: Per-record; default CC BY-NC
media_license: Per-photo CC (default CC BY-NC); some all-rights-reserved
recommended_citation: No official string; cite GBIF iNaturalist Research-grade dataset DOI
notes: Filter photos by license before glossary use

name: GBIF
auth: None for reads; HTTP Basic (free account) for downloads
bulk_access: Yes: async DwC-A downloads, cloud snapshots
data_license: Per-dataset: CC0 / CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-NC 4.0
attribution_requirement: Retain ownership identifier; acknowledge publishers; cite DOI
recommended_citation: Cite download DOI, e.g. 'GBIF.org (date) GBIF Occurrence Download https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.xxxx'
notes: Use download DOIs for every dossier snapshot

name: Biodiversity Heritage Library
bulk_access: Yes: monthly Figshare exports (OCR 40GB+), AWS Open Data
data_license: Metadata CC0; public-domain content free; permissioned in-copyright CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
attribution_requirement: 'Image from the Biodiversity Heritage Library. Contributed by [Holding Institution]. | www.biodiversitylibrary.org'
recommended_citation: Per-item; no single API citation
notes: Primary source for Illustrated Glossary historical plates; check CopyrightStatus per item

name: iDigBio
data_license: Per-recordset: CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA/CC BY-NC/CC BY-NC-SA; default CC BY
attribution_requirement: Provider attribution included in API responses
recommended_citation: Follow GBIF practice; portal downloads include citation file
notes: Herbarium images useful for glossary morphology

name: Global Biotic Interactions (GloBI)
data_license: Index CC BY 4.0 (GitHub); underlying records per source
attribution_requirement: Cite original datasets first, then GloBI
recommended_citation: Poelen JH, Simons JD, Mungall CJ (2014) Ecological Informatics. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecoinf.2014.08.005
provenance: 3d09cd07 (Biodiversity APIs Licensing Comparison, 2026-07); 9cd36f3b (OREP Relationship Extraction Review, 2026-05)
notes: Core Matrix backbone; carry per-record citation

name: EOL TraitBank
auth: JWT; 'power user' approval by EOL admin
bulk_access: Yes: full TraitBank dump (~652 MB), registration required
data_license: Mixed per-record: CC BY/BY-SA/BY-NC/BY-NC-SA; CC0 summaries
recommended_citation: Cite original source; EOL citation optional
notes: Prefer bulk dump over gated API

name: UNITE
data_license: CC BY 4.0 (GBIF-registered checklist)
recommended_citation: Abarenkov K et al. 2024. Nucleic Acids Research. https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkad1039
notes: CC BY-SA claim on mirror unconfirmed

name: Plants of the World Online (POWO)
api_endpoint: No official public API (unofficial pykew wrapper)
data_license: CC BY (Kew Science data terms; per-dataset licence field)
commercial_use: Yes with attribution, unless record states otherwise
recommended_citation: POWO (year). Plants of the World Online. Facilitated by the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. Published on the Internet; http://www.plantsoftheworldonline.org/ Retrieved [date].
notes: Site blocks automated fetch; rely on WCVP for pipelines

name: World Checklist of Vascular Plants (WCVP)
bulk_access: Yes: DwC-A via GBIF, Kew download
data_license: CC BY 4.0
recommended_citation: Govaerts R et al. (2021) Scientific Data 8:215. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-021-00997-6
notes: Recommended primary orchid name backbone; pin release

name: International Plant Names Index (IPNI)
api_endpoint: No public API (beta); RDF via /rdf or LSID
bulk_access: No official bulk; RDF per record
data_license: CC BY
recommended_citation: IPNI (year). International Plant Names Index. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Harvard University Herbaria & Libraries and Australian National Herbarium. http://www.ipni.org [accessed date]
notes: Links names to BHL protologues

name: World Flora Online
api_endpoint: WFO Plant List snapshots; portal download
data_license: Backbone CC0; content per contributor
recommended_citation: See WFO FAQ 'How to cite WFO'
notes: Cross-check against WCVP

name: Catalogue of Life
primary_role: Cross-kingdom names for pollinator and fungal partners
data_license: CC BY 4.0 (site content, unless indicated); source checklists CC0/CC BY
recommended_citation: Cite specific COL release DOI from ChecklistBank
notes: Use for non-orchid partner taxa

name: NCBI Taxonomy / GenBank
rate_limits: 3 req/s without key, 10 with key (NCBI E-utilities docs; not re-verified)
data_license: US Government public domain; some contributed material copyrighted
recommended_citation: Cite NCBI Taxonomy database paper
notes: Rate limits from known docs; re-check before production

name: IUCN Red List
data_license: IUCN Terms of Use; no CC license
recommended_citation: IUCN (year). The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species. Version [x]. https://www.iucnredlist.org
notes: HIGH RISK: may restrict non-conservation visualization; store status + link, not redistribute full assessments

name: Species+ / CITES Checklist
data_license: Terms of use page not retrievable
recommended_citation: UNEP (year). Species+. UNEP-WCMC, Cambridge, UK. www.speciesplus.net
notes: Terms page returned error; confirm before ingestion. Nearly all orchids are CITES-listed

name: Plazi TreatmentBank
bulk_access: Yes: DwC-A per treatment, RSS list, GBIF datasets
data_license: Open access; Plazi considers treatments not copyrightable (exact license not confirmed this pass)
media_license: Figures via Biodiversity Literature Repository (Zenodo), per-record license
attribution_requirement: Cite original article and treatment DOI
recommended_citation: Agosti D, Egloff W (2021) BISS 5:e75690. https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.5.75690
notes: Confirm license on GBIF dataset records for each treatment

name: OpenAlex
primary_role: Scholarly metadata, citation graph, OA discovery
auth: No key for basic use; free key gives 10x budget
rate_limits: Daily budget; max 100 req/s; per_page max 100
data_license: CC0 (per OpenAlex; not re-quoted this pass)
recommended_citation: Priem J, Piwowar H, Orr R (2022) arXiv:2205.01833
notes: Do not purchase paid plan

name: Crossref REST API
rate_limits: Not stated on page; use polite pool (mailto)
data_license: Facts essentially uncopyrightable, use for any purpose; abstracts may be copyrighted
recommended_citation: n/a
notes: Do not reuse abstracts verbatim in dossiers

name: Europe PMC
primary_role: Full text of OA articles for extraction
data_license: Per article; only OA subset licensed for text mining
recommended_citation: Cite original articles
notes: Restrict extraction to CC BY / CC0 OA subset

name: Global Names Verifier
data_license: License not stated for service output; open-source software
recommended_citation: n/a
notes: Tool, not content source

name: Plant Ontology (PO)
data_license: CC BY 4.0
recommended_citation: Cite PO release and Cooper et al. (Plant Ontology Consortium)
notes: Anchor for Lexicon term IDs

name: Darwin Core (TDWG)
data_license: CC BY 4.0
recommended_citation: Darwin Core Maintenance Group. Darwin Core. TDWG. https://dwc.tdwg.org

name: Wikidata
data_license: CC0 (structured data)
recommended_citation: n/a
notes: Multilingual vernacular names for Lexicon

name: Wikimedia Commons
data_license: Per-file (PD, CC BY, CC BY-SA, GFDL)
recommended_citation: Per-file credit line
notes: Exclude BY-SA if derivative illustrations must stay non-copyleft

name: TRY Plant Trait Database
bulk_access: File Archive unrestricted unless owner restricts; main DB by request
data_license: Per-dataset; no archive-wide license
attribution_requirement: Cite original publication and TRY package
recommended_citation: Kattge J et al. (2020) Global Change Biology 26:119-188
notes: Main database requests carry conditions; check per dataset
